morphology.pattern_note: 本词无词缀；派生时，meN- 在 p 前变为 mem-，词根首音 p 脱落：meN- + puja → memuja。

senses.zh_definition: 向神灵、神像等表达尊崇的祭拜仪式。
senses.en_definition: A ritual performed to honour or worship deities or sacred images.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis upacara penghormatan kepada dewa-dewa, berhala dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 词根主要指祭拜仪式；“崇拜某人、迷恋某人”的动词通常用 memuja。puja pantai 是特定传统仪式名称；puja umur 是庆祝诞辰的旧式表达。参见 [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=puja)。

dual_scenarios.context: 博物馆说明 / 文化报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran itu menerangkan sejarah upacara puja pantai dalam kehidupan masyarakat nelayan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览介绍了渔民社会中海滨祭祀仪式的历史。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition explains the history of coastal propitiation ceremonies in fishing communities.

dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才博物馆里有介绍海滨祭祀，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: There was something about coastal rituals at the museum earlier, right?

etymology.historical_story: Puja belongs to the Sanskrit religious vocabulary that entered Malay through contact with Indian traditions. Sanskrit pūjā denotes worship or reverence. Malay preserves the ceremonial meaning in puja, while derivatives such as memuja also express intense admiration or love. This creates a memorable bridge between ritual devotion and figurative adoration. See [Sanskrit pūjā](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=puja) and [Malay usage](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=puja).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pu-ja 想成祭拜时的两拍动作：献供、致敬。puja 是仪式，memuja 是进行祭拜或崇拜。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述不同宗教的仪式时，应采用当事群体认可的称呼；不要随意用带贬义的评价替代中性说明。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合宗教、历史和民俗语境。普通称赞一般用 puji；表达尊重通常用 hormat，避免无意中赋予祭拜或过度崇拜的意味。
